0022600130.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-2, 2.5 games back in 4th in the Pacific, 14th in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 2 games back in 3rd in the Southwest, 10th in the West), with the Kings on a two-game losing streak and the Spurs riding a one-game winning streak. The Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while the Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not played yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Spurs won the last meeting 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026, after sweeping the 2025-26 season series 3-0.
